clauses.title: The review-only driver sequences helpers through the packaged CLI
CL-D93 records the driver boundary
clauses.section: ## CL-D93 — A packaged driver sequences the review; the parent only makes the calls it prints
requires: Giving the driver a writing operation, reading validation commands from the head, or computing `contractInput` from the target checkout requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: CL-D93 states what readiness reads and what the owner reads
clauses.section: ## CL-D93 — A packaged driver sequences the review; the parent only makes the calls it prints
requires: Readiness takes external findings only from unresolved review threads and review states: pull-request conversation comments and `COMMENTED` review bodies are not evaluated as findings, and the owner who merges reads them (https://github.com/tetsuh/pi-tidd-agents/issues/203#issuecomment-5900278433). CL-D96 later added `autofix.js`, `paths.js`, and `writer.js` to `driver/` and reset the aggregate driver alarm to 100,000 bytes.

clauses.title: The CL-D93 fixtures drive a review round
requires: Issue #196 the packaged review-only driver runs a PR round to MERGE_READY; the parent only makes printed calls
Issue #196 a malformed .tidd.json at the base, or an issue without acceptance criteria, stops before any gate
